author: NorthEast News Desk
body: German federal prosecutors charged seven suspected Hamas members in Berlin on Friday with belonging to a foreign terrorist organization and preparing an attack, including by obtaining weapons.

Prosecutors said the men acted on orders from senior Hamas figures and secured a fully automatic rifle, 13 pistols and more than 700 rounds of ammunition. Authorities allege the weapons were intended for an attack in Germany or Austria around the second anniversary of the October 7, 2023 Hamas-led attacks on Israel.

The intended targets were Israeli representatives, Jewish people or people viewed as pro-Israel, prosecutors said. German domestic intelligence has previously warned that Hamas or affiliated individuals were attempting to establish covert logistics networks in the country for weapons procurement and attack planning.

All seven suspects remain in custody, Reuters reported. The charges move the case into a new legal phase but do not establish guilt; the allegations will be tested in court. German authorities have not announced a trial date in the initial report.
dek: Federal prosecutors say the men obtained firearms and ammunition for a planned 2025 attack in Germany or Austria.
headline: Germany charges seven suspected Hamas members over attack plot
